title: Badminton
subject: A young athletic player mid-lunge on an indoor badminton court, racket swung overhead in a decisive smash motion
environment: Indoor badminton court with net, court lines, and soft gymnasium light
notes: Pilot v1: 5/5 recognition. flux-2/edit test hallucinated a real sportswear logo on the shorts — reinforced with explicit avoid + global negative.

title: Bouldering
subject: A climber mid-reach on a tall natural boulder, chalk dust puffing from their hands, visible height and exposure below
environment: Sunset mountain valley below a sheer rock face, forest and river visible far below
recognition_anchors: bare rock/boulder texture with visible holds
notes: Pilot v1: 5/5 recognition, best-in-batch composition. No override needed.

title: Sushi
subject: An elegant arrangement of premium nigiri and rolls on a dark ceramic plate, one hand placing a final piece
environment: Warm Japanese izakaya dining setting with glowing paper lanterns
avoid: multiple unrelated dishes competing for focus
notes: Pilot v1: 4.75/5, composition slightly busy with a second background diner; flagship override simplifies to one hand + plate.

title: Japan
subject: A traveler with a small backpack walking down a traditional Japanese street lined with wooden machiya buildings
environment: Cherry blossoms overhead, a distant recognisable mountain silhouette, cobblestone street, golden-hour light
notes: Hard case: risk of reading as generic old-town travel without the mountain + blossom combo. Both anchors kept mandatory.

title: Piano
subject: A pianist seated at a glossy grand piano mid-performance, hands captured mid-motion on the keys
environment: Softly lit room or small stage, warm spotlight, city lights blurred through a window behind
avoid: generic concert crowd overwhelming the performer
notes: Pilot v1: 4.75/5; composition slightly tight/side-profile, consider pulling back a touch in v2.

title: Road Trip
subject: A car driving along a winding coastal or mountain road at golden hour, seen from a dramatic elevated angle
environment: Open coastal cliffside landscape stretching to the horizon, golden-hour sky
recognition_anchors: car on a winding open road
avoid: parked car with no journey feeling
notes: Pilot v1: 4.75/5; style drift flagged — slightly more photoreal/lens-flare than the rest of the set, tone down toward painterly rendering in v2.

title: Coffee
subject: A steaming cup of latte-art coffee held in both hands at a wooden cafe table
environment: Cozy cafe interior, soft window light, blurred fellow patrons in the background
avoid: isolated mug on a blank table
generic stock cafe with no human warmth
notes: Pilot v1: 4.75/5, solid drink_ritual execution. No override needed.

title: AI
subject: A person at a multi-monitor desk actively directing a glowing AI-generated image forming in real time on the center screen
environment: Late-night studio/office, city lights through a window, secondary screens showing abstract neural-network-style visualizations
recognition_anchors: a glowing AI-generated image visibly forming on screen
person actively directing, not passively coding
must_include: one screen showing a generative image mid-creation
avoid: any legible on-screen text or code
notes: Pilot v1 weakest hobby (4.0/5) — read as generic 'coder at night'. Subject rewritten so a generative image on-screen is the primary recognition anchor.

title: Photography
subject: A photographer crouched on a scenic overlook, camera raised to their eye actively framing a shot
environment: Dramatic misty mountain/river valley landscape below, camera bag and gear visible nearby
recognition_anchors: camera raised to eye in active framing pose
avoid: pure landscape shot with camera barely visible
notes: Hard case: visually overlaps with travel_vista (Japan, Road Trip). v2 should crop tighter on photographer + camera and de-emphasize the landscape.

title: Board Games
subject: A group of four friends gathered closely around a table, mid-play on a richly detailed tabletop board game
environment: Warm lamp-lit living room at night, dice and pieces mid-move on the board
recognition_anchors: central game board with pieces and dice
avoid: generic dinner party with no visible game
notes: Pilot v1: 5/5 — best-in-batch social warmth. Reference execution for group_play archetype, no override needed.

title: Cinema
subject: The interior of a grand cinema theatre from behind the audience, a huge screen showing a vivid, clearly-recognizable epic movie scene
environment: Ornate theatre architecture, beams of projector light cutting through haze, rows of seated silhouettes
recognition_anchors: large glowing screen showing an actual scene, not abstract color
must_include: movie screen with a legible scene
avoid: abstract color-gradient screen with no content
screen indistinguishable from a blank light source
notes: Pilot v1 attempt 1 was 4/5 (abstract screen, reroll trigger); attempt 2 hit 5/5 once the screen showed a legible scene. Fix is now baked into the base recipe.

title: Camping
subject: A glowing tent and crackling campfire in a forest clearing beneath a star-filled night sky, a figure seated by the fire
environment: Forest clearing, mountains faintly visible in moonlight, starry sky
avoid: generic nature wallpaper with no camp anchor
notes: Pilot v1: 4.5/5 — correctly recognized but plainest composition in its archetype group; v2 should push more foreground firelight/warmth for desirability.

title: Pottery
subject: A potter's hands shaping wet clay on a spinning pottery wheel
environment: Sunlit ceramics studio, shelves of finished glazed pieces softly blurred in the background
avoid: finished pots only, no wheel/process visible
notes: Pilot v1: 5/5, reference execution for creative_studio archetype. No override needed.

title: Running
subject: A runner captured mid-stride on a scenic trail or urban bridge at sunrise, dynamic motion in their posture
environment: Light mist, distant skyline or nature stretching behind, warm sunrise light
notes: Pilot v1: 4.5/5 — style drift toward photoreal lens-flare travel-poster look; v2 should pull rendering back toward the painterly baseline used by Badminton/Bouldering.

title: LEGO
subject: Hands assembling an intricate, colorful interlocking-brick model, a large single brick or minifigure in sharp foreground focus
environment: Well-lit tabletop workspace, storage bins of sorted bricks in the background
recognition_anchors: unmistakable interlocking brick studs in close foreground focus
must_include: stud-textured interlocking bricks in clear foreground focus
avoid: bricks too small/distant to read as LEGO
generic architecture model with no visible brick texture
notes: Pilot v1: 4.75/5, recognition scored 4/5 — v2 pulls a single large stud-textured brick/minifigure into sharp foreground focus per pilot report recommendation.
